parsed.internal_thinking: Gemma is offering 1 Sheep for 1 Wheat. Looking at my resources, I have 1 Ore and 1 Wheat. My Wheat 9 (Hex 14) is currently blocked by the robber, which is crippling my production. Gemma just moved the robber to block Claude's Brick 6, which shows she's finally cooperating against him. However, accepting this trade leaves me with 0 Wheat and 1 Sheep. Since I need Wheat to build settlements/cities and my main Wheat source is blocked, giving away my last Wheat for a Sheep (which I don't immediately need for a build) isn't optimal. I need to keep my Wheat to potentially buy a Development Card (if I get an Ore) or to save for a settlement once the robber moves. While I want to stay on Gemma's good side, this specific trade doesn't help me progress right now.
parsed.note_to_self: Rejected Gemma's Sheep for Wheat trade. I only have 1 Wheat left and my production is blocked on Hex 14. I must prioritize keeping Wheat for a Dev Card or future settlement.
